nodes.label: cli()
nodes.desc: Parses command-line flags (-I, -P, -U, -K), wires SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers, then boots the Server and calls start()

nodes.label: Server
nodes.desc: Top-level orchestrator: loads config.json, owns the PluginManager, BridgeService, child bridge map and IPC service

nodes.label: HomebridgeAPI
nodes.desc: API v2.7 EventEmitter handed to every plugin; registerAccessory/registerPlatform calls funnel back through its internal events

nodes.label: PluginManager
nodes.desc: Discovers homebridge-* packages in global node_modules (plus -P custom path) and drives their load/initialize cycle

nodes.label: Plugin
nodes.desc: Wraps one npm package: resolves its entry point, dynamic-imports it, stores registered accessory/platform constructors

nodes.label: BridgeService
nodes.desc: Owns the single Bridge accessory, the accessory cache handlers and external accessory publishing

nodes.label: Bridge publish
nodes.desc: publishBridge() sets AccessoryInformation, builds PublishInfo (username/pin/port) and hands the bridge to hap-nodejs

nodes.label: @homebridge/hap-nodejs
nodes.desc: Dependency implementing the HomeKit Accessory Protocol: HAPServer, Accessory/Bridge classes, mDNS advertiser, pairing

nodes.label: PlatformAccessory
nodes.desc: Plugin-facing accessory wrapper with context storage and _associatedPlugin/_associatedPlatform used by the cache

nodes.label: User
nodes.desc: Resolves storage paths under ~/.homebridge: config.json, persist (hap-nodejs), accessories (cache)

nodes.label: ChildBridgeService
nodes.desc: Supervises one forked Node process per _bridge config; restart/stop/start via IPC

nodes.label: ChildBridgeFork
nodes.desc: Server inside the forked child: loads exactly one plugin and builds its own API, PluginManager and BridgeService
